a.speaker: Fireworks
a.text:
Somebody's cousin lights a fountain at the end of the court. A big shepherd mix bolts its leash and comes straight down the sidewalk at {dog.name}, hackles up.

{teen.name} is watching you, not the dogs.

options.text: Throw your jacket over its head and hold on.
Call {dog.name} back and step between them.
Shove the shepherd hard into the hedge.

calm.speaker: Fireworks
calm.text: The shepherd's owner arrives at a run, red-faced and apologizing. Nobody bleeds. {teen.name} files it away: when things break, this is what we do.

bitten.speaker: Fireworks
bitten.text: The jacket slips and the dog gets a mouthful of your forearm before its owner drags it off. Nothing deep. Your heart takes longer to slow than your arm does. (+8 Strain.) A missed gate never dead-ends a scene.

shove.speaker: Fireworks
shove.text: It yelps and runs. The owner gives you a look you will see again. {teen.name} files it away too.
